studies.title: The astrolabe in the Islamic world
studies.caption: Astronomers of Abbasid Baghdad build and refine the astrolabe, a brass model of the sky for telling time and measuring the height of stars.
studies.prompt: Large close oblique study of a small brass planispheric astrolabe suspended by its top ring, finely cut openwork star-pointer rete and nested circular plates; an Abbasid scholar handles it carefully at a Baghdad window about800CE. No telescope, no fantasy gears, no readable labels.
